metadata.interpretation: Editorial clinical-relevance matches, not statistical correlations or validated triage rules. Multiple symptoms and patient context are needed before recommending care.
metadata.data_quality: The source specialties arrays can repeat terms and may contain text merged from unrelated facilities. Occurrences count repeated array entries; facility_rows counts rows containing a term.
metadata.normalization: Readable title case; merged case, punctuation, British/US spellings, and a conservative set of exact specialty synonyms. Distinct subspecialties are retained.
metadata.counts: Occurrences include repeated entries; facility_rows counts distinct rows per canonical specialty.
